text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was almost certainly not a factor in choosing him over you. While an all-male panel may reflect broader representation issues within the firm or industry, it provides no evidence of sex-based discrimination against you. Raising gender bias in this context would appear baseless, damaging your professional reputation and burning bridges.

The decision likely came down to relevant skillset: executive risk roles heavily emphasize regulatory compliance, which aligned with the other candidate's background. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your feedback request, framing it constructively around how you might strengthen your regulatory profile for future senior appointments.
